def run(_context):
    import adsk.core, adsk.fusion, adsk.cam
    app = adsk.core.Application.get()
    doc = app.activeDocument
    print("Doc:", doc.name)
    products = doc.products
    for i in range(products.count):
        p = products.item(i)
        print("Product:", p.productType)
    # CAM
    cam = adsk.cam.CAM.cast(products.itemByProductType('CAMProductType'))
    if cam:
        print("Setups:", [s.name for s in cam.setups])
        for s in cam.setups:
            print(" Setup", s.name, "ops:", [o.name for o in s.operations])
    # Design
    design = adsk.fusion.Design.cast(products.itemByProductType('DesignProductType'))
    if design:
        root = design.rootComponent
        print("Bodies:", [b.name for b in root.bRepBodies])
    return "ok"

def run(_context):
    import adsk.core, adsk.fusion, adsk.cam
    app = adsk.core.Application.get()
    design = adsk.fusion.Design.cast(app.activeProduct if app.activeProduct.productType=='DesignProductType' else app.activeDocument.products.itemByProductType('DesignProductType'))
    root = design.rootComponent
    body = root.bRepBodies.item(0)
    bb = body.boundingBox
    print("BBox min (cm):", bb.minPoint.asArray())
    print("BBox max (cm):", bb.maxPoint.asArray())
    print("Num faces:", body.faces.count)
    for i,f in enumerate(body.faces):
        geo = f.geometry
        t = type(geo).__name__
        info = ""
        if t=='Cylinder':
            info = "radius=%.4f cm axis=%s origin=%s" % (geo.radius, geo.axis.asArray(), geo.origin.asArray())
        fb = f.boundingBox
        print(i, t, info, "z:[%.3f,%.3f]"%(fb.minPoint.z, fb.maxPoint.z), "area=%.3f"%f.area)
    return "ok"

def run(_context):
    import adsk.core, adsk.fusion, adsk.cam
    app = adsk.core.Application.get()
    design = adsk.fusion.Design.cast(app.activeDocument.products.itemByProductType('DesignProductType'))
    root = design.rootComponent
    body = root.bRepBodies.item(0)
    # detail plane faces
    for i,f in enumerate(body.faces):
        if type(f.geometry).__name__=='Plane':
            fb=f.boundingBox
            n=f.geometry.normal.asArray()
            print(i,"Plane normal",["%.2f"%x for x in n],
                  "x:[%.3f,%.3f] y:[%.3f,%.3f] z:[%.3f,%.3f]"%(fb.minPoint.x,fb.maxPoint.x,fb.minPoint.y,fb.maxPoint.y,fb.minPoint.z,fb.maxPoint.z),
                  "area=%.3f"%f.area)
    return "ok"
